Definition: perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth
BiblicalUsage: Thummim is one of the two sacred objects in the high priest's breastplate, named beside the Urim. In Exodus 28:30, thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim. Aaron the high priest carried them in his breastplate when he went in before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Thummim matters because God gave His people a way to seek His will, and He still guides those who ask Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
